category_law: Burden analysis derived from observed synthetic behaviour. No requalification was performed in this lane and no court was rerun.
headline: The accepted R7 runtime identity does NOT change. No modified pyreadstat/ReadStat binary is required. The burden is therefore much smaller than the commission's rebuild-conditional section anticipated.

commission_condition_applies.condition: If a modified pyreadstat/ReadStat binary is required...
commission_condition_applies.reason: The broker route uses the accepted binary unmodified. There is no new build, no new artifact, and no divergence to reconcile.

does_R7_runtime_identity_change.reasoning: R7 identity is a property of the interpreter and installed package set. Neither is touched. The accepted environment was not mutated in place; all work ran against it read-only.

what_does_change.component: the application's own decode call site
what_does_change.nature: It hands pyreadstat an open, governed file object instead of a path string.
what_does_change.blast_radius: Confined to the decode and batch call sites that are deliberately routed through the broker.

which_courts_must_rerun.reason: The enforcement surface changes. Guards now sit at the broker rather than at a Python-level interception point, and the chunked DTA path acquires the fresh-broker-per-chunk requirement (defect D1). Existing C3 evidence was gathered against a different mechanism.
Same reason as C3. The environment is unchanged but the exercised code path through it is not.

can_previous_source_free_55_of_55_qualif.reasoning: The 55/55 result characterised the runtime as it behaves when given path strings. The broker route changes the argument the reader receives. Reusing the prior result unchanged would be asserting equivalence across a change that has not been tested.
what_can_be_reused: The corpus itself. The 55 carriers remain valid test inputs; they do not need to be regenerated or re-authorised.
The expected outputs, as a comparison baseline.
what_must_be_repeated: The full decode comparison over all 55 carriers, path-based versus brokered, at whatever grain the 55/55 court originally declared.
The chunked/batch comparison, with the fresh-broker-per-chunk loop for DTA.
The negative/enforcement cases, re-executed against the broker guards.
can_previous_source_free_55_of_55_qualif.estimated_shape_of_the_work: A re-execution and comparison pass over an existing corpus with an existing baseline, plus a metadata-field diff that this lane did not perform. Not a rebuild, not a re-authorisation, not a new corpus.

new_reviewer_acceptance_required_before_: Independent hostile review of the claim that the compiled reader performs zero opens on the broker route. This lane's basis is source reading plus synthetic behaviour; a reviewer should confirm there is no residual path-based open.

Acceptance that a de facto duck-typed seam, not a documented callback contract, is being relied upon, together with a pinning decision that fixes the pyreadstat version so the seam cannot change underneath.
Acceptance of defect D1 (fresh broker per chunk for DTA) as a permanent design constraint rather than a bug to be fixed later.
Acceptance that byte ceilings are pre-read gates with a one-read overshoot, not byte-exact cuts.
A decision on whether every reader call site is routed through the broker, since any site still passing a raw path string remains ungoverned. An inventory of such sites was NOT produced in this lane.
explicitly_not_established_here: That the change is safe to adopt in production. It is not proposed.
That real-source governance works. Zero real sources were touched.
That all reader call sites in the application are covered.
